segments.text: As the planar center of mass, X two partitions triangle A B C into three sub-triangles of equal area, giving barycentric coordinates one, to one, to one, and trilinear distances inversely proportional to the side lengths, one over a, to one over b, to one over c. On the central lines layer, X two anchors both the Euler line through X three, X four, and X five, and the Nagel line through X one, X eight, and X ten.

segments.text: Under functional relations, X two is the isogonal conjugate of the Symmedian point X six, its own isotomic conjugate, and the fixed center of the complement and anticomplement dilations. Across all four reference triangles, X two divides the segment from Circumcenter X three to Orthocenter X four in the exact ratio one to two.
